summary.en: The stream arc: scattered → threaded → dispatched → gathered. One thread takes over a pile of loose work, the product names itself, each task leaves as a star, a bigger job becomes a constellation, a result passes a check, three cards show what stays, and the thread gathers every star into one panel before winding back into the name.
summary.zh: stream 的骨架：散乱 → 串联 → 派出 → 收束。一根线接走一堆散乱的事，产品自我介绍，每件任务化作星派出，一件大活连成星座，结果通过核对，三张卡展示留下的东西，线把所有星收回一个面板，再缠回成名字。

fits: Launch films of agents and assistants that take work off people, 75–120 s.
notFor: Short teasers under a minute; products that do not run things for the user.

intent.en: Tell handing work off as one thread that takes everything, sends it out and brings it all back to one place.
intent.zh: 把“把事交出去”讲成一根线：接走一切、派出去、再全部带回一处。

content.en: Scenes for each slot (see the card); the night-sky look and the stream-bed sound.
content.zh: 每个槽的场景（见卡片）；night-sky 样式与 stream-bed 声音。

fits.zh: 替人接活的 agent、助手的发布片，75–120 秒。

notFor.zh: 一分钟以内的短预告；不替用户跑事情的产品。

en: The order is fixed and each scene comes once; the days, the interlude and the lock-up are optional (the template itself draws its nine scenes, with the lock-up). A film that drops the lock-up ends on its own composition over the interlude, which must land the name or the mascot.
The two climaxes must be the constellation (about half-way) and the gather (about 83 %); swapping their order loses the build.
zh: 顺序固定，每场一次；多日、夜空插段和落版可选（模板本身画九场，含落版）。不要落版的片子在夜空插段上用自己的合成收尾，这个合成要落到名字或吉祥物上。
两个高潮必须是星座（约一半处）和收束（约 83%）；对调顺序就失去了递进。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
